children: Lemon Tree Hotels has opened Lemon Tree Premier, Jabalpur, marking its entry into the city and taking its operational presence in Madhya Pradesh to four hotels, with 11 more properties in the pipeline. The hotel is managed by Carnation Hotels, a wholly owned subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels.

Located on Naudra Bridge, the 80-room and suite property caters to business and leisure travellers. Facilities include Citrus Cafe, a multi-cuisine coffee shop; Slounge, a recreation bar; in-room dining; banquet and meeting spaces; a spa; swimming pool; and fitness centre.

Vishvapreet Singh Cheema, President, Lemon Tree Hotels, said, "The opening of Lemon Tree Premier, Jabalpur adds an important dimension to our footprint in Madhya Pradesh, strengthening our ability to serve its diverse business, administrative and leisure travel markets.
With an established portfolio in Indore and Bhopal, and a leisure-led presence in Bandhavgarh, our entry into Jabalpur further broadens our network across some of the state’s key travel corridors.

Located right in the city centre, this hotel is well positioned to serve the city’s growing business and institutional demand, while also catering to travellers exploring the wider region. With this opening, we now have four operational hotels in the state, with eleven more properties in the pipeline. Our focus is to build a well-diversified portfolio that gives us relevance across the different demand centres of the region."

The hotel is approximately 2 km from Jabalpur railway station, 6.5 km from ISBT and 16 km from Jabalpur Airport. Nearby attractions include Bhedaghat, Dhuandhar Waterfall, Madan Mahal Fort and Balancing Rocks.
